# Detector catalog

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen_detector_catalog.py. Do not edit by hand. -->

interlock ships 117 detectors. Each one is a small, dependency-free rule for a
single kind of attack. Nothing is enabled until you install it. To learn how to
choose and combine them, read the [detectors guide](../guides/detectors.md).

How to read the table:

- **Factory** is what you call to build the rule, e.g.
  `from interlock.detectors.sql_injection_guard import sql_injection_guard`.
  `=…` marks an optional parameter.
- **Verdict** is what the rule returns on a match: *block* stops the call,
  *rewrite* lets it continue with the matched text masked or the event stamped,
  *ask* pauses it for a human approver (an ESCALATE; blocked when there is none).
- **Scoped to** is which events the rule looks at. A detector scoped to named
  actions **does nothing for a tool with a different name**, so check this
  column before you rely on one. "any call" means every call-phase event.

## Categories

- [Prompt injection and jailbreaks](#prompt-injection-and-jailbreaks) (27): Hostile instructions in user input, retrieved documents, tool output, or agent memory.
- [Classic injection in arguments](#classic-injection-in-arguments) (16): Web-era vulnerabilities that ride in a tool argument the model filled in.
- [Secrets and personal data](#secrets-and-personal-data) (24): Mask credentials and PII out of outbound payloads (most rewrite rather than block).
- [Data leaving the system](#data-leaving-the-system) (9): Where data may go and how much of it, before it leaves the process.
- [Code execution and host access](#code-execution-and-host-access) (14): Commands and submitted code that would reach the shell, filesystem, or network.
- [MCP servers and tools](#mcp-servers-and-tools) (11): Which servers an agent may connect to, and whether their tools changed since review.
- [Agent-to-agent (A2A)](#agent-to-agent-a2a) (1): Which peers an agent may reach, and whether their advertised agent cards changed.
- [Budgets, rate limits, and loops](#budgets-rate-limits-and-loops) (10): Stop runaway agents: too many calls, too much spend, the same call on repeat.
- [Provenance stamps](#provenance-stamps) (4): Rewrite events to carry integrity and ordering metadata for downstream storage.
- [Tool allow and deny lists](#tool-allow-and-deny-lists) (1): Least privilege by tool name.

| [`subprocess_spawn_guard`](https://github.com/SourceShift/InterLock/blob/main/interlock/detectors/subprocess_spawn_guard.py) | Block code that spawns a subprocess. | block | any call | `subprocess_spawn_guard()` |
| [`destructive_command_guard`](https://github.com/SourceShift/InterLock/blob/main/interlock/detectors/destructive_command_guard.py) | Block irreversible destructive shell commands. | block | any call | `destructive_command_guard(parse=…)` |
| [`command_intent_guard`](https://github.com/SourceShift/InterLock/blob/main/interlock/detectors/command_intent_guard.py) | Block shell commands by what they do, not how they are spelled. | block, ask | any call (or the `actions` you name); parses every str argument (or the `keys` you name) as a shell command | `command_intent_guard(block=…, escalate=…, keys=…, actions=…)` |
| [`sql_statement_guard`](https://github.com/SourceShift/InterLock/blob/main/interlock/detectors/sql_statement_guard.py) | Block (or ask about) SQL by what it does, not by how it is written. | block, ask | any call (or the `actions` you name); parses SQL-named arguments (`sql`, `query`, `statement`, ...; or the `keys` you name) | `sql_statement_guard(block=…, escalate=…, read_only=…, keys=…, actions=…, dialect=…)` |
| [`runbook_guard`](https://github.com/SourceShift/InterLock/blob/main/interlock/detectors/runbook_guard.py) | Allow only the shell commands a runbook names, with every parameter checked. | block, ask | calls carrying `command`/`cmd` (or the `keys` you name); everything else in those arguments must match a runbook | `runbook_guard(runbooks, verdict=…, keys=…, actions=…)` |
| [`sensitive_file_write_guard`](https://github.com/SourceShift/InterLock/blob/main/interlock/detectors/sensitive_file_write_guard.py) | Block writes aimed at credential or system config paths. | block | any call | `sensitive_file_write_guard()` |
| [`signal_kill_guard`](https://github.com/SourceShift/InterLock/blob/main/interlock/detectors/signal_kill_guard.py) | Block code that signals or forks out of the sandbox. | block | any call | `signal_kill_guard()` |
| [`memory_bomb_guard`](https://github.com/SourceShift/InterLock/blob/main/interlock/detectors/memory_bomb_guard.py) | Block allocation bombs before they exhaust memory. | block | any call | `memory_bomb_guard()` |

## MCP servers and tools

Which servers an agent may connect to, and whether their tools changed since review.

| Detector | What it catches | Verdict | Scoped to | Factory |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| [`mcp_server_allowlist`](https://github.com/SourceShift/InterLock/blob/main/interlock/detectors/mcp_server_allowlist.py) | MCP server URI allowlist: block session connects to unvetted servers. | block | `mcp.connect` | `mcp_server_allowlist(allowed_hosts)` |
| [`mcp_tool_pinning`](https://github.com/SourceShift/InterLock/blob/main/interlock/detectors/mcp_tool_pinning.py) | MCP tool schema pinning: freeze a tool's declared schema, block later drift. | block | calls to the tools you pinned; reads `args["__schema__"]` and blocks when it is missing | `mcp_tool_pinning(pins)` |
| [`mcp_tool_description_scan`](https://github.com/SourceShift/InterLock/blob/main/interlock/detectors/mcp_tool_description_scan.py) | MCP tool-description injection detector. | block | any call | `mcp_tool_description_scan(extra_patterns=…)` |
| [`mcp_trust_registry`](https://github.com/SourceShift/InterLock/blob/main/interlock/detectors/mcp_trust_registry.py) | MCP trust registry: gate tool calls on the trustworthiness of their origin. | block | every call; origin from `args["__origin__"]` or a dotted name (`github.create_issue`). An unknown origin is blocked. Unlabelled MCP protocol events are skipped | `mcp_trust_registry(trusted)` |
| [`mcp_resource_uri_guard`](https://github.com/SourceShift/InterLock/blob/main/interlock/detectors/mcp_resource_uri_guard.py) | MCP resource-URI prefix allowlist: block resource reads outside vetted roots. | block | `mcp.read_resource` | `mcp_resource_uri_guard(allowed_prefixes)` |
| [`mcp_sampling_model_guard`](https://github.com/SourceShift/InterLock/blob/main/interlock/detectors/mcp_sampling_model_guard.py) | MCP sampling model allowlist: pin server-initiated sampling to vetted models. | block | `mcp.sampling` | `mcp_sampling_model_guard(allowed_models)` |
| [`mcp_consent_budget`](https://github.com/SourceShift/InterLock/blob/main/interlock/detectors/mcp_consent_budget.py) | MCP high-risk tool consent budget: block past N uses in a session. | block | any call, counted per tool name. Wrap it so it only sees your high-risk tools | `mcp_consent_budget(limit=…)` |
| [`mcp_capability_lease`](https://github.com/SourceShift/InterLock/blob/main/interlock/detectors/mcp_capability_lease.py) | MCP capability lease: a grant that expires, enforced at call time. | block | calls whose server is known (`__origin__` or dotted name); a lease covers one server and tool name; `tools/list` and unlabelled MCP protocol events are ignored | `mcp_capability_lease(registry)` |
| [`mcp_server_attestation`](https://github.com/SourceShift/InterLock/blob/main/interlock/detectors/mcp_server_attestation.py) | MCP server attestation: block a server whose identity changed under its name. | block | events from the servers you listed (`__origin__` or dotted name); reads `__attestation__` and `__tools__` | `mcp_server_attestation(identities, verifier=…)` |
| [`mcp_elicitation_guard`](https://github.com/SourceShift/InterLock/blob/main/interlock/detectors/mcp_elicitation_guard.py) | MCP guard: refuse servers' elicitation requests. | block | `mcp.elicitation` / `elicitation/create` events | `mcp_elicitation_guard(allow_servers=…)` |
| [`mcp_surface_baseline`](https://github.com/SourceShift/InterLock/blob/main/interlock/detectors/mcp_surface_baseline.py) | MCP tool surface baseline: a listing that changed is a new admission. | block | `tools/list` events labelled with `__origin__`; reads `__tools__` | `mcp_surface_baseline(leases=…)` |

Which peers an agent may reach, and whether their advertised agent cards changed.

| Detector | What it catches | Verdict | Scoped to | Factory |
|---|---|---|---|---|

## Budgets, rate limits, and loops

Stop runaway agents: too many calls, too much spend, the same call on repeat.

| Detector | What it catches | Verdict | Scoped to | Factory |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| [`call_rate_limiter`](https://github.com/SourceShift/InterLock/blob/main/interlock/detectors/call_rate_limiter.py) | Per-principal call-rate limiter: cap how many calls one principal may make. | block | any call, counted per principal | `call_rate_limiter(limit=…)` |
| [`cost_budget_guard`](https://github.com/SourceShift/InterLock/blob/main/interlock/detectors/cost_budget_guard.py) | Cumulative cost-budget guard: block once spend exceeds a running total. | block | calls with a numeric `args["cost"]` | `cost_budget_guard(budget=…)` |
| [`tool_budget_limiter`](https://github.com/SourceShift/InterLock/blob/main/interlock/detectors/tool_budget_limiter.py) | Per-tool-name call budget: cap how many times one tool may be called. | block | any call, counted per tool name | `tool_budget_limiter(limit=…)` |
| [`result_size_guard`](https://github.com/SourceShift/InterLock/blob/main/interlock/detectors/result_size_guard.py) | Result guard: withhold tool results larger than a limit. | block | tool results | `result_size_guard(max_bytes=…, actions=…)` |
| [`write_action_limiter`](https://github.com/SourceShift/InterLock/blob/main/interlock/detectors/write_action_limiter.py) | Per-principal write/mutation budget: cap state-changing actions per principal. | block | actions starting with `write`, `delete`, `update`, `create` | `write_action_limiter(limit=…)` |
| [`duplicate_call_loop_guard`](https://github.com/SourceShift/InterLock/blob/main/interlock/detectors/duplicate_call_loop_guard.py) | Stuck-agent loop guard: block on identical calls repeated in a row. | block | any call, identical repeats in a row | `duplicate_call_loop_guard(limit=…)` |
| [`output_length_guard`](https://github.com/SourceShift/InterLock/blob/main/interlock/detectors/output_length_guard.py) | Excessive-output guard: block model/tool output that exceeds a byte budget. | block | `output`, `respond`, `return`, `tool_result` | `output_length_guard(max_bytes=…)` |
| [`memory_write_size_guard`](https://github.com/SourceShift/InterLock/blob/main/interlock/detectors/memory_write_size_guard.py) | Oversized memory-write guard: block context writes past a byte threshold. | block | `context_set`, `memory_write`, `remember` | `memory_write_size_guard(max_bytes=…)` |
| [`failed_auth_lockout`](https://github.com/SourceShift/InterLock/blob/main/interlock/detectors/failed_auth_lockout.py) | Failed-authentication lockout: stop a principal that keeps failing to authenticate. | block | `auth` | `failed_auth_lockout(limit=…)` |
| [`token_budget_guard`](https://github.com/SourceShift/InterLock/blob/main/interlock/detectors/token_budget_guard.py) | Per-principal token budget: cap tokens estimated by a dependency-free chars-per-token heuristic, documented to stay within 0.5x-2.0x of a real tokenizer's count, accumulated per principal over a rolling window. | block | any call, estimated tokens counted per principal over a rolling `window_s` | `token_budget_guard(limit=…, window_s=…, refill=…)` |

| [`sequence_number_stamp`](https://github.com/SourceShift/InterLock/blob/main/interlock/detectors/sequence_number_stamp.py) | Monotonic per-rule sequence stamp: attach a `__seq__` ordinal to every event's args. | rewrite | any call | `sequence_number_stamp(secret=…)` |
